messages:
maria: Heads-up—planning to pin kestrel:2b -> kestrel:2b@v2 during the quiet window tonight 22:00 UTC. Owners: @devin deploy, @sarah smoke/QA, @tim rollback. Can everyone confirm availability?

devin: I can handle the deploy. Which canary fraction are we doing? Also need the exact model alias update command.

sarah: I can take smoke. Will run perf + correctness quick sets (5 reps).

maria: Thanks. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 20m if metrics look good, then full swap. Command to pin (ops CLI): `rdctl model pin kestrel:2b --version v2 --alias kestrel:2b`

tim: I'll be on-call for rollback. Rollback command is `rdctl model rollback kestrel:2b --to-version v1` and I have the playbook open.

oleg: Capacity check—we have 2 spare compact slots in eu-west-1, should be fine for canary. I filed capacity ticket #INC-5732 just in case.

ci-bot: Pipeline kestrel-pin-v2 · build #842 · status: passed ✅ (artifacts: model-image:sha256:9afe1c)

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- sanity gen 3 samples (small prompt)
- latency SLO check (<180ms p50 for 128 tokens)
- token cost sanity (no huge regression)
- log sampling for 2 requests
```

sarah: Got it. Smoke commands I'll run: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://inference.internal/models/kestrel:2b@v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'` and `./tools/smoke_check.py --model kestrel:2b@v2 --samples 5`. Posting results in thread.

devin: During canary I'll route 10% via the routing policy `route:set kestrel:2b --weight 10 --version v2` and monitor CPU/GPU. Autoscale unchanged.

maria: Monitoring: Grafana dashboard (models/kestrel-2b) and SLO alerts to #eng-sre. If p95 latency > 400ms or error rate > 1% during canary, rollback immediately.

tim: Agreed. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds hit and notify on #eng-ml + @oncall.

oleg: One operational note—the KV cache warmup may spike CPU for first 3 minutes. Watch memory.

sarah: I'll capture quick before/after latencies and post numbers. If all green, I'll ack and we promote to 50%.

maria: Minor config change to commit after smoke (so ops knows):
```yaml
model_catalog:
  kestrel:2b:
    pinned_version: v2
    owner: eng-ml
```

devin: lgtm. I'll do the pin at 22:00 UTC unless someone asks to delay.

maria: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll proceed as scheduled. Closing in 10 min for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:

sarah: ready. :white_check_mark:

tim: standing by.

oleg: available.

maria: final check — no blockers reported, proceeding 22:00 UTC. I'll post a short status update during rollout.
